# DockPanel { #anylumino.DockPanel }

```python
DockPanel(
    widgets=None,
    *,
    titles=None,
    keys=None,
    mode='split-right',
    width='100%',
    height=520,
    resizable=True,
)
```

Lumino dock panel for tabbed or split workspace-style layouts.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                                         | Default       |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| widgets   | iterable or mapping                                                               | Child widgets or keyed child mapping. Mapping keys become stable child keys and default tab titles. | `None`        |
| titles    | iterable or mapping                                                               | Tab titles associated with children.                                                                | `None`        |
| keys      | iterable of str                                                                   | Stable child keys for iterable ``widgets``.                                                         | `None`        |
| mode      | (\'tab-after\', \'split-right\', \'split-left\', \'split-top\', \'split-bottom\') | Placement mode used as children are added to the dock layout.                                       | `"tab-after"` |
| width     | int, float, str, or None                                                          | Widget width.                                                                                       | `'100%'`      |
| height    | int, float, str, or None                                                          | Widget height.                                                                                      | `520`         |
| resizable | bool                                                                              | Whether the dock panel gets a notebook resize handle.                                               | `True`        |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [layout_kind](#anylumino.DockPanel.layout_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
| [mode](#anylumino.DockPanel.mode) | An enum whose value must be in a given sequence. |
